caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental, shield-shaped object with intricate openwork design, rendered in grayscale on a light, slightly stained background. The object has a pointed, triangular base and gradually widens upward. At the top, two looped forms resembling stylized scrolls or eyes are joined together, forming the handle or upper part. Beneath this, a circular motif is centrally placed, surrounded by sweeping, curved lines. Below the circle, two symmetrical animal-like figures, facing each other, are positioned within the upper half of the shield; their forms are abstract yet appear to have legs and elongated bodies. The central portion of the shield contains another roundel with concentric circles, and the lower part of the shield features a downward-pointing, textured element reminiscent of a shell or fan. The frame of the object is outlined by a thick, continuous border. The drawing is signed with the name "G. Lorens" in the lower left corner.
title: Trivet
